title: Chapter 232 The Seventh Master Of Pegasus Village
content:
Chapter 232 The Seventh Master Of Pegasus Village

Each of Wang Shuo's 400 archers was equipped with a strong bow. With Zou Yuanjie's "high morale" and the legion order, their combat effectiveness was further improved, which was incomparable to ordinary archers.

This round of arrow rain directly reduced the number of horse bandits on the opposite side by nearly 100 people.

Before they rushed to the front of the position, the horse bandits had already suffered more than 200 casualties.

This made the leaders of the horse bandits extremely angry.

Even the second leader was shot by an arrow. He stretched out his hand and pulled out the arrow directly, shouting: "Kill!"

"Shoot!" Gong Kai shouted again.

After the second round of arrow rain, the horse bandits finally rushed to the front of the position.

At this time, the shield soldiers immediately returned to their positions to protect the archers in the back.

After rushing up the uphill road for nearly one kilometer, the impact force of the horse bandits had been attenuated to the limit.

The mud pit trap in front of the position also caused a lot of trouble for the horse bandits.

The archers in the position directly stepped onto the high platform temporarily built with wood.

On top, they can also effectively shoot at the horse bandits blocked by the shield soldiers.

Now, it depends on whether the 200 shield soldiers and 200 black mountain bandits can withstand the melee attack of more than 500 horse bandits.

The two sides fought a fierce hand-to-hand fight.

Due to the rush of time, the fortifications on the hill were very simple.

Wang Shuo was also afraid of building strong fortifications. If the horse bandits on the opposite side did not attack, it would be embarrassing!

Just when the fierce battle was in full swing, Ayub and Li Jianguo, with the soldiers of the crossbow battalion, quietly walked down the hill from the rear.

Wang Shuo looked at the military advisor Zou Yuanjie beside him and grinned: "Military advisor, are you afraid?"

"Afraid? Although I am a weak scholar, I also have a passion, what is there to fear?"

"Okay! Protect yourself!"

Wang Shuo looked at the leaders on the opposite side, who were invincible on the battlefield, and it was difficult for ordinary soldiers to resist.

In a few breaths, several soldiers were killed.

The number of generals on Wang Shuo's side was far less than that of the opponent, and they still showed signs of decline when they fought hand-to-hand.

The defensive formation of the shield soldiers was broken by some horse bandit generals.

Gong Kai immediately commanded the archers to focus on several of the opponent's leading generals, and they could barely force the opponent's generals to defend.

Wang Shuo did not hesitate and directly selected an opponent to fight with him.

[Balga Wa (Seventh Leader of Feima Village)]

[Level: Level 39 (Intermediate General)]

[Attack Power: 620]

[Defense Power: 220]

[Health Points: 5600]

[Skill: Bloodthirst]

This should be the weakest general on the opposite side.

Seeing Wang Shuo rushing over, Balga Wa showed a cruel smile on her face.

"Bloodthirst" was activated, and her eyes were bloodshot and red.

Wang Shuo jumped high, holding the gun with both hands, and the long gun turned over his head and smashed it hard at Balga Wa.

Although Bhargava's eyes were red, he did not lose his mind. He knew that he could not resist this attack.

He rolled to the side and avoided Wang Shuo's attack.

Wang Shuo used the tip of his gun to stab Bhargava's rolling position continuously, and for a while, Bhargava was beaten in a mess.

Just as Wang Shuo was chasing after the victory, an arrow flew over.

"Lord, be careful!" Zou Yuanjie exclaimed immediately.

Wang Shuo looked up and his pupils shrank suddenly. Why did this arrow have a familiar smell?

This arrow was shot by Gude.

Wang Shuo quickly dodged to the side, holding the gun with both hands and smashing it hard at the arrow.

Finally, the arrow was knocked away.

But the power of this arrow was so great that Wang Shuo felt a little numb in both hands.

Because there were still many soldiers between Gude and Wang Shuo, the two just glanced at each other and focused on the opponent in front of them.

Wang Shuo's attack was interrupted, and Bhargava stood up with a somersault, angrily saying, "You, are looking for death!"

After that, he brandished his two swords and rushed towards Wang Shuo.
